paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness 可视化侧边栏 Skill 智能管理器：智能分类管理、使用建议、适合多skill文档人员快速找到合适可使用的skill进行工作
# dsh-skill-manager
Adds a **smart classification + smart usage-suggestion** layer to a DeepSeek Harness skill library:
once you have dozens of skills, you can still tell at a glance which one to use.
English | 中文

> **v0.3.0** — from "skill file manager" to "skill navigator". Two things changed:
> **① smart class

ification** (by product/project stage, not by literal words)
> **② smart usage suggestions** (what e
ach skill does and when to use it).
Filtered by the 运营增长 stage — the result of smart classification:
## Why this exists
With a handful of skills, `/name` is enough. With twenty or thirty, the problem changes:
- **You don't know what you have** — skills live under project, user and `.agents` roots; which one

wins, and which is shadowed by a same-named skill, is invisible.
- **You don't know which one to use
** — every `SKILL.md` has rules, but nobody remembers "which one for sprint planning", "which one fo

r API design".
- **Names don't match purposes** — what is the difference between `analysis-funnel` a

nd `analysis-retention`? You have to open and read both.
- **You're afraid to clean up** — switching
a skill off means editing or deleting files.
This plugin turns finding, recognising and managing skills into a few rows and switches in a panel.
## The two capabilities unique to this version
### 1. Smart classification: understand the *stage*, not the words
One click on "AI 智能归类" and the model reads each skill's name, description and **body excerpt**, deci
des where it sits in the delivery flow, and files it into a fixed stage taxonomy:
> 需求分析 · 商业论证 · 方案设计 · 原型美工 · 开发实现 · 测试验收 · 上线部署 · 运营增长 · 成本优化 · 协作管理 · 其他
- The taxonomy is **closed**: the model may only pick from it, so you never get `decision` / `applic

ation` style fragments;
- Large libraries are sent in **batches** (12 per call) so a long list canno

t make the model return an empty response;
- When the model is unavailable it falls back to a **stag
e keyword table** (funnel/conversion → 运营增长, token/compression → 成本优化…) — still stages, never plain

word clustering;
- Categories you created by hand are never overwritten: generated ones carry an `au
to` flag and only those are replaced on a re-run.
### 2. Smart usage suggestions: one generated line per skill
Opening the panel adds, **under the original description**, a line that explains the skill:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- Generated **automatically** for every skill; a global 显示 AI 建议 switch can turn it off;
- Stored in
a side file (`$DSH_HOME/skill-manager/suggestions.json`) and **never written into `SKILL.md`**; has

hed against file content, so stale suggestions disappear;
- "一键生成 / 重新生成全部 AI 建议" for the whole libr

ary, plus per-row regeneration;
- Output language: Chinese or English.
**Both features answer the same question**: with many skills you neither find nor recognise the righ
t one. Classification tells you *which step of the flow* it belongs to; the suggestion tells you *wh
at it does and when to use it*.
## Everything else
| Capability | Detail |
| **Enable / disable** | A registry policy override — **source files untouched**, instantly reversib

le, restored on uninstall. |
| **Default load** | Three scopes merged: **global**, **this project**

(matched by project root), **by preset** (e.g. `standard`). |
| **Categories** | Create / rename / d

elete, optional keywords, many-to-many membership, closable card. |
| **Import** | Clipboard (paste
a whole `SKILL.md`), directory (host-native picker), ZIP (unpacked on the host, traversal rejected).

|
| **Edit SKILL.md** | Create / edit / delete in the panel; kebab-case validation, never overwrite

s, preserves unmanaged frontmatter keys. |
| **Shadow reporting** | Flags skills hidden by a higher-

ranked root. |
| **First-class sidebar entry** | A `main` panel plus a `sidebar.panellist` row, not
buried in Settings. |
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the DeepSeek Harness app (host plugins load at startup), then refresh; **技能管理** appears in t
DeepSeek Harness app (host plugins load at startup), then refresh; **技能管理** appears in the sidebar.
## Configuration
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `provider` / `model` | `deepseek-account` / `deepseek-flash` | Model used for AI suggestions and c

lassification |
| `includeDefaultRoots` | `true` | Scan project and user roots |
| `customSkillDirs`

| `[]` | Extra roots at rank 300 |
| `bundledSkillDir` | `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR` | Read-only root

at rank 600 |
| `dshHome` / `agentsHome` | `$DSH_HOME` / `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME` | Root resolution base |
| `log` | `true` | Append to `$DSH_HOME/skill-manager/skill-manager.log` |
## How it works
- **Host half** (`lib/`): a rank 0 override provider for enable/disable; `systemPrompt.section` for
default loading; endpoints under the official `/api` channel via `connection.fetch.register`; prefer

ences in `$DSH_HOME/skill-manager/preferences.json`, suggestions in `suggestions.json`.
- **Browser
half** (`client/src/client/`): registers a `main` panel and a `sidebar.panellist` entry; bundled as

a `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` module that depends on `react` alone.
- **AI**: go
es through the host's `ctx.llm`, prompts for JSON only, retries once, then falls back to the stage k
e host's `ctx.llm`, prompts for JSON only, retries once, then falls back to the stage keyword table.
## Verification
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Measured on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 desktop:
- isolated instance 10/10: suggestions never touch the original file, regeneration works, stage clas

sification comes from the model, all 27 skills assigned;
- UI verified by mounting the real build ar
tifact in jsdom: auto-generation, the global switch writing to preferences, search filtering, scoped

default loading;
- after disabling a skill, `/registry` reports `provider: skill-manager` and `mode
lInvocable: false` — the override really wins in the live registry.
